title: Senior Manager (Corporate Communications & PR)
description:
Job description


Senior Manager (Corporate Communications & PR)
 
Your role in summary
The Senior Manager is a pivotal role within our team, responsible for developing and executing communication strategies and action plans. In this capacity, you will act as the principal point of contact for our clients, ensuring their satisfaction and retention through dedicated service and the application of V+O principles and values. This role requires close collaboration with the Director/ Business Unit Director, and involves a strong focus on client advisory, especially in areas of corporate communications, public affairs, policy research and analysis.
Key Responsibilities:

Develop and manage corporate communication strategies and action plans under the direction of the Director/ Business Unit Director.
Advise clients on public affairs and stakeholder engagement in coordination with the Director/ Business Unit Director.
Build, manage, and nurture existing client relationships, ensuring continual deepening of these relationships through client satisfaction, development, and retention.
Serve as the project owner for the portfolio, maintaining client KPIs and reports, and proposing actionable recommendations based on outcomes.
Proactively anticipate client needs and provide relevant, timely recommendations.
Responsible for creating all copywriting materials (Press Releases, Q&A documents, interviews, speeches) in line with agreed strategy.
Build and maintain strong relationships and networks with the media and other stakeholders per client needs.
Oversee client’s press office activities under the supervision of Director/ Business Unit Director.
Organize and ensure the timely, budget-compliant completion of all project deliverables.
Support crisis communications under the supervision of Director/ Business Unit Director.
Conduct research on policy issues at national, European, and international levels, and monitor legislation and regulations relevant to client’s business interests.
Undertake the people manager role, managing, training, guiding, and developing team members in accordance with company values and management processes.
Cooperate with external providers, ensuring performance and compliance with company policies.
Manage the completion of all client-related administrative tasks (databases, ISO files, etc.) on time and in accordance with company policies and procedures.

QUALIFICATIONS AND STANDARDS: 
Education & Experience 
 
Essential
- University degree in Business Administration, Media Communications, Public Relations, Journalism, or Political Science
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills in both Greek and English
- Minimum 5 years of relevant working experience in a PR firm or in a Corporate Communication Department
Desirable 
- A master's or advanced degree in a relevant field, demonstrating a higher level of expertise.
- Advanced experience in crisis communications
Join us for a challenging career! 
We offer an exciting business framework for you to accelerate professionally as well as a competitive remuneration package and benefits both numerical and non-numerical. We work with great clients, from SMB to global corporations, on a variety of communication challenges, to create compelling and persuasive experiences through insightful planning, innovative thinking, and seamless execution.
If you want to become a member of our team, please send us your CV at careers@vando.gr 
 
Your application will be handled with the utmost confidentiality!

description: Etraveli Group is the globally leading company for tech solutions and fulfillment capabilities for online sales of flights. We are here to solve complexity, by connecting millions of flights and travelers across the globe, from search and selection to trip and beyond. We hold consumer online travel agency brands like Mytrip, GoToGate & Flight Network and serve Booking.com with flights. Etraveli Group has also established strategic partnerships with companies like Skyscanner, Google Flights, TUI, etc. Every day we strive to make the world smaller for our customers and bigger for our people. Our diverse team of more than 2400 passionate professionals is what makes us the industry’s tech wonder and the best in the world at what we do. Our major offices are in Sweden (HQ), Canada, Greece, India, Poland with the Athens office being one of the largest, hosting around 580 employees working from the center of Athens for the rest of the world. Join us and start as Payments Risk Operations Specialist in the Risk Management team!Position SummaryIf you are captivated by mind games, you possess strong investigation skills and can see patterns behind numbers and scattered pieces of information, it’s highly likely that Payments Risk Operations Specialist would be your dream job!As a Payments Risk Operations Specialist your main responsibility will be to protect Etraveli Group from financial losses due to fraudulent activities while maintaining sales and customer experience in top performance. Besides screening high risk transactions, this role should also propose innovative improvements in existing processes. The ideal candidate must have excellent investigation, problem solving and decision making skills and is expected to be up-to-date with the latest online fraud trends as well as with potential fraud screening tools.Responsibilities Screen potentially high-risk transactions accurately and in a timely manner utilizing a wide range of fraud prevention systems, tools and reports. Identify fraud patterns or abnormalities and take appropriate actions to prevent similar activities and mitigate potential future fraud. Thoroughly process and analyze fraud alerts received from external sources. Ensure transaction authenticity by contacting customers via phone and/or email. Propose innovative improvements to our existing processes, aiming to further enhance our fraud prevention and detection strategies Deliver dynamic tasks & provide support for a wide range of business analyses. Stay up to date with the latest online fraud trends, practices, and tools through continuous learning & research. Be a problem-solver. Requirements Bachelor’s degree and/or studies preferably in Science, Technology, Engineering, Mathematics. Excellent command of the English language. Advanced experience with MS office (especially Excel) Data driven approach along with strong critical, analytical and investigation skills. Ability to act proactively, take initiatives and demonstrate a can-do attitude focusing on producing high quality results within a fast-paced environment. Team player with strong interpersonal and communication skills including the ability to effectively interact with clients.  Work independently, meet tight deadlines while navigating multiple systems and processes Discretion in dealing with confidential information. High level of responsibility & integrity combined with eagerness to work in a multicultural, international environment subject to continuous changes. Previous work experience as a Fraud Analyst will be considered a plus  Availability to work on shifts around the clock (24/7) – 8-hour shifts, 5 days per week including weekends and bank holidays.  BenefitsWe are looking for people who would make the world smaller for travelers but want a bigger world of opportunities for themselves. With us you can enjoy: #LI-Hybrid working environment - having the opportunity to work both remotely and at the office enabling you flexibility! Health Benefits - Through partners we offer a private health insurance plan. We also offer the possibility to use 2 extra medical leave days in case of need. Monthly ticket restaurant card - to spend in one of the thousands affiliated restaurants, cafes, stores or supermarkets across Greece. Office in the City – We sit on bright, large floors (over 4000㎡!) in central Athens. Just a short walk from the Ambelokipi Metro station. Growth – We believe in personal development and continuous education, thus we offer the opportunity of role-related training on tools and best practices. We also like to schedule company/department/team activities and events outside the office space! We have a relaxed & fun work environment where you can enjoy free breakfast coffee/tea, playing ping pong or video games.
